decisions.reason: As a newly launched safety-shoe line with several models, it likely involved meaningful development and production investment, so management is inclined to persist rather than admit an early mistake.
This comfort insole appears to be a smaller and less publicly emphasized launch, so it is easier to drop than the shoe lines, but after only a year management would still tend to give it more time.
Like the other standalone insole, it seems to require less sunk investment and less public justification, yet the short time since launch still favors continuation over withdrawal.

The ergonomic safety-shoe series had its own webpage and multiple models, indicating visible commitment and substantial investment that escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to reverse quickly.

The firefighter and rescue boot line is a specialized multi-model range that likely needed notable development and certification effort, making management more likely to stay committed despite any early uncertainty.
Because the moulded insole was presented as a flagship and shown on the home page, dropping it would most clearly contradict the firm's public direction and write off a highly visible commitment.
